data.title: Indiana American Water and American Water Charitable Foundation Support Disaster Recovery Efforts Across Indiana
data.description: A total of $70,000 in funding has been allocated to aid various communities in their recovery efforts following severe storms and flooding. This financial assistance will benefit areas such as Northwest Indiana, Muncie, Richmond, Noblesville, and Cambridge City. The support is being provided by Indiana American Water in collaboration with the American Water Charitable Foundation (AWCF). The funding is aimed at helping these communities rebuild and restore infrastructure and services that were damaged due to the natural disasters.

data.title: Tennessee American Water Completes Tank Hoist
data.description: A new water storage tank has been successfully hoisted into place in Lookout Valley, Chattanooga. This new addition doubles the water storage capacity in the area. The tank is set to enhance the water supply infrastructure in the region significantly following its activation.
